title: Korean-Style Spicy Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry made with Korean noodles, myeongnan sauce, and a variety of exotic ingredients. This dish is perfect for those who enjoy a little heat in their meals.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the gochujang and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the roasted peanuts and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the sliced red onion and scallions, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the onions are slightly softened.
Season with myeongnan sauce to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Optional: top with roe for added richness and flavor.
